verdict.rationale: Customer.io's AI agent/MCP docs explicitly describe setting up recurring tasks the agent runs on a schedule (deliverability reports, segment audits, broadcast recaps), and the core platform natively supports automations/workflows triggered on events or segments. This directly matches the story of scheduling recurring jobs via AI-native tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the recurring-task scheduler and more detail on scheduling flexibility (cron-like control, failure handling).
